comment: The load and save button beside the mode button is drawn on the panel and configured as a parameter, but the plugin never reads it, so its line says that nothing reads it and the tag points there. DENSITY at its centre gives a grain overlap of exactly zero: the granular processor leaves overlap at 0 for values between 0.47 and 0.53, and the sample player scales the grain count by the cube of overlap, so no grains are sown until the knob leaves that band. A trigger at TRIG still sows one.
